```{r data_import}
# ---- 1. Load data & normalize names ----
df <- read_csv(here("data/city", "salesSFapr2023toMarch2025Updated.csv")) |>
  rename_with(tolower)    # clean_names()
```

```{r datas}
# 1) PRICE CLASS (final version in SPSS uses 5 buckets)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    priceclass = case_when(
      saleprice <  48000 ~ 1L,   saleprice <  67000 ~ 2L,
      saleprice <  94000 ~ 3L,   saleprice < 134000 ~ 4L,
      is.finite(saleprice) ~ 5L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    priceclass = factor(priceclass, levels = 1:5,
                        labels = c("Below 48000", "48000 to 67000", "67000 to 94000",
                                   "94000 to 134000", "134000+"))
  )

# 2) Filter by style (IN variable)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    in_style = if_else(sresb_style %in% c("SINGLE FAMILY", "1/2 DUPLEX"), 1L, 0L)
  ) %>% filter(in_style == 1)

# 3) Deduplicate (keep the last record within PARCELNO+SALEPRICE+SALEDATE)
# SPSS logic: sort ascending, mark LAST=PrimaryLast, keep PrimaryLast==1
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    parcelno = as.character(parcelno),
    # Optional: mimic SPSS "replace '.' with 'P' and '-' with 'D'"
    parcelno_std = parcelno %>% str_replace_all("\\.", "P") %>% str_replace_all("-", "D")
  ) %>% arrange(parcelno_std, saleprice, saledate) %>%
  group_by(parcelno_std, saleprice, saledate) %>% slice_tail(n = 1) %>% ungroup()

# 4) Remove "price equals assessment" (non-market) transactions
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    priceisasmt_ratio = avwhensold / saleprice,
    priceisasmt_ratio2 = if_else(priceisasmt_ratio >= 0.90 & priceisasmt_ratio <= 1.10,
                                 1, priceisasmt_ratio),
    priceisasmt_ratio = priceisasmt_ratio2, priceisasmt = if_else(priceisasmt_ratio == 1, 0L, 1L)
  ) %>% filter(priceisasmt == 1)

# 5) OUT filters for bad data (lot too small, floorarea too small, saleprice too low)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    out_bad = case_when(
      stotalsqft < 400 ~ 1L, sresb_floorarea < 400 ~ 1L, saleprice < 10000 ~ 1L, TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>% filter(out_bad == 0)

# 6) SPPSF and log transform
df <- df %>% mutate(sppsf = saleprice / sresb_floorarea, ln_sppsf = log(sppsf))

# 7) Story height bins + style/story interaction binaries
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    onestory = if_else(sresb_styhgt <= 2, 1L, 0L),
    twostory = if_else(sresb_styhgt > 2 & sresb_styhgt <= 5, 1L, 0L),
    single_family1story = if_else(sresb_style == "SINGLE FAMILY" & onestory == 1, 1L, 0L),
    half_duplex1story   = if_else(sresb_style == "1/2 DUPLEX" & onestory == 1, 1L, 0L),
    half_duplex2story   = if_else(sresb_style == "1/2 DUPLEX" & twostory == 1, 1L, 0L)
  )

# 8) Era built (yearbuilt buckets) + binaries
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    erabuilt = case_when(
      sresb_yearbuilt < 1910 ~ 1L,  sresb_yearbuilt < 1930 ~ 2L,
      sresb_yearbuilt < 1946 ~ 3L,  sresb_yearbuilt < 1961 ~ 4L,
      sresb_yearbuilt <= 1990 ~ 5L, sresb_yearbuilt > 1990 ~ 6L,      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    # Binaries (SPSS: combine 1+2; 4 is base; combine 5+6)
    yb_pre_1929     = if_else(erabuilt %in% c(1, 2), 1L, 0L),
    yb_1946_to_1960 = if_else(erabuilt == 4, 1L, 0L),
    yb_post_1961    = if_else(erabuilt %in% c(5, 6), 1L, 0L)
  )

# 9) Condition binaries (SCOND 3 base; missing treated as base in SPSS)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    good = if_else(scond == 2, 1L, 0L), fair = if_else(scond == 4, 1L, 0L),
    poor = if_else(scond == 5, 1L, 0L), very_poor_unsound = if_else(scond %in% c(6, 7), 1L, 0L)
  )

# 10) Bathrooms binaries (one bath base)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    two_plus_baths = if_else(sresb_fullbaths %in% 2:10, 1L, 0L),
    powder_room    = if_else(sresb_halfbaths %in% 1:5, 1L, 0L)
  )

# 11) Fireplace
df <- df %>% mutate(fireplace = if_else(sresb_fireplace %in% 1:6, 1L, 0L))

# 12) Basement/crawl/slab
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    pctcrawl = sresb_crawspace / sresb_groundarea, pctslab = sresb_slabarea / sresb_groundarea,
    pctbsmnt = sresb_basementarea / sresb_groundarea,
    crawl = if_else(pctcrawl > pctbsmnt & pctcrawl > pctslab, 1L, 0L),
    slab  = if_else(pctslab  > pctcrawl & pctslab  > pctbsmnt, 1L, 0L)
  )

# 13) Quality grade binaries (2 is base)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(qabove_avg = if_else(sresb_bldgclass %in% c(3, 4, 5), 1L, 0L),
    qbelow_avg = if_else(sresb_bldgclass %in% c(0, 1), 1L, 0L))

# 14) Garages (presence, type, spaces, log)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    garage = if_else(sresb_garagearea >= 200, 1L, 0L),
    one_car_garage = if_else(sreb_gartype == 1, 1L, 0L),
    two_car_garage = if_else(sreb_gartype == 2, 1L, 0L),
    garagespaces = case_when(
      sresb_garagearea > 200 & sresb_garagearea < 420 ~ 1L,
      sresb_garagearea > 419 & sresb_garagearea < 600 ~ 2L,
      sresb_garagearea > 599 & sresb_garagearea < 820 ~ 3L,
      sresb_garagearea > 819 ~ 4L,      TRUE ~ 0L
    ), ln_garagespaces = if_else(garagespaces > 0, log(garagespaces), NA_real_)
  )

# 15) Street class: ARTERIAL vs all others
df <- df %>% mutate(arterial = if_else(rd_class %in% c("A21", "A31"), 1L, 0L))

# 16) Heat/cooling binaries (forced air base)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    hot_water = if_else(sresb_heat == 2, 1L, 0L), elec_baseboard = if_else(sresb_heat == 3, 1L, 0L),
    wall = if_else(sresb_heat %in% c(6, 8), 1L, 0L), central_air = if_else(sresb_heat == 9, 1L, 0L)
  )

# 17) Size categories from floorarea + binaries (3 is base)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    size = case_when(
      sresb_floorarea <  830 ~ 1L,      sresb_floorarea < 1018 ~ 2L,
      sresb_floorarea < 1255 ~ 3L,      sresb_floorarea < 1632 ~ 4L,
      is.finite(sresb_floorarea) ~ 5L,  TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    smallest = if_else(size == 1, 1L, 0L),    small = if_else(size == 2, 1L, 0L),
    large    = if_else(size == 4, 1L, 0L),    largest = if_else(size == 5, 1L, 0L)
  )

# 18) Time variables (SMONTH, SYEAR, MONTHS)
# SPSS:   MONTHS=0 #   if 2022: smonth-5 #   if 2023: smonth+7 #   if 2024: smonth+19
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    smonth = lubridate::month(saledate),    syear  = lubridate::year(saledate),
    months = case_when(
      syear == 2023 ~ smonth - 5,      syear == 2024 ~ smonth + 7,
      syear == 2025 ~ smonth + 19,      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
# SPSS spline vars (NOTE: these are 0..9/7/8 style splines; keep identical)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    months_1to9  = pmin(months, 9),    months_10to16 = pmin(pmax(months - 9, 0), 7),
    months_17to24 = pmax(months - 16, 0)
  )

# 19) BUILDING SIZE + LOT SIZE RATIO VARIABLES (medians by style)
# Base building size medians from SPSS notes:
#   SINGLE FAMILY median = 1056 #   1/2 DUPLEX   median = 840
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    base_bldgsize = case_when(
      sresb_style == "SINGLE FAMILY" ~ 1056, sresb_style == "1/2 DUPLEX"   ~ 840, TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    base_bldgsize_ratio = sresb_floorarea / base_bldgsize,
    ln_base_bldgsize_ratio = log(base_bldgsize_ratio),
    ln_sbldsf_bsz_single = if_else(sresb_style == "SINGLE FAMILY", ln_base_bldgsize_ratio, 0),
    ln_sbldsf_bsz_halfduplex = if_else(sresb_style == "1/2 DUPLEX", ln_base_bldgsize_ratio, 0)
  )

# Base lot size medians from SPSS notes:
#   SINGLE FAMILY median lot = 4599 #   1/2 DUPLEX    median lot = 3180
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    base_lotsize = case_when(
      sresb_style == "SINGLE FAMILY" ~ 4599, sresb_style == "1/2 DUPLEX" ~ 3180, TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    base_lotsize_ratio = stotalsqft / base_lotsize,
    ln_base_lotsize_ratio = log(base_lotsize_ratio),
    landratio = stotalsqft / base_lotsize,    landratio2 = landratio,
    landratio2 = if_else(landratio2 >= 0.90 & landratio2 <= 1.10, 1, landratio2),
    landratio2 = if_else(sresb_style != "SINGLE FAMILY" & landratio2 > 3, 3, landratio2),
    landratio2 = if_else(sresb_style == "SINGLE FAMILY" & landratio2 > 4, 4, landratio2),
    ln_landratio = log(landratio2)
  )

# Alternative building size transforms (as in SPSS)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    lnsbldsf    = log(sresb_floorarea),    sbldsfint   = (sresb_floorarea - 432),
    lnsbldsfint = if_else(sbldsfint > 0, log(sbldsfint), NA_real_),
    sblds_fmed  = (sresb_floorarea - 1051),
    lnsbldsfmed = if_else(sblds_fmed > 0, log(sblds_fmed), NA_real_)
  )
```

```{r datamod1}
df <- df |> rename(ecf = secf)
df <- df %>% mutate(ln_price = log(saleprice))

df <- fastDummies::dummy_cols(
  df,  select_columns = "ecf",  remove_first_dummy = TRUE,   # avoids singularity
  remove_selected_columns = FALSE
)
ecfs_col <- grep("^ecf_", names(df), value = TRUE)
```

```{r datsav}
d_f <- df
save(d_f, ecfs_col, file = here("data/rdata", "CODsalesSFapr23Mar25.RData"))
```
